what: The persistent worker POOL taking CONCURRENT claims, proven both deterministically (loopback) and cross-machine (host coordinators -> VM pool). The pool bounds in-flight delegations to --concurrency N; excess concurrent claims queue FIFO and drain as slots free.

deterministic.detail: 5 concurrent claims against a pool of N=2: peak in-flight provider calls = 2 (mock with an 80ms delay), every claim ACKed + returned DONE verdict=pass, pool drained (done=5, running=0, queued=0), and the pool stayed up to complete a further claim (persistent).

crossMachine.worker: lba-ubuntu-scratch on VM lba-ubuntu2404-labview2026-scratch, `node worker.mjs --listen 7440 --concurrency 2 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b`
crossMachine.coordinators: 3 host coordinators in parallel (observe 7421/7422/7423), tasks T-POOL-1/2/3, reply 10.0.2.2
crossMachine.provider: host Ollama llama3.1:8b, reached from the VM at 10.0.2.2:11533 (TCP proxy)
crossMachine.observed: the pool ran 2 concurrently and queued the 3rd (queued reached 2), draining to 0 as slots freed; all three claims returned verdict=pass.

note: The scratch VM powered off shortly after this run completed (worker SSH exit 255, then VM state=poweroff). The pool proof had already completed and was confirmed by both the worker log and the three coordinators before the VM went down; the deterministic proof is independent. The temporary NAT forward + Ollama proxy were removed.
